title: VirtualTour tour v1
description: A guided tour stored as JSON and loaded with parseTourJson. Functions are named handlers, elements are CSS selectors.

$schema.title: Schema reference
$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor support. Ignored by the parser.

format.title: Format
format.description: Document format and major version. Parsers refuse any other value.

id.title: Tour id
id.description: Identifier used for persistence and the tour registry. Defaults to a slug of the name plus a random suffix.

dim.title: Dim
dim.description: true draws the dimmed overlay with defaults, false draws none, an object configures it.

mountIn.title: Mount in
mountIn.description: CSS selector of the element the popover is mounted in. Resolved when the tour starts; no match is an environment error.

dimMountIn.title: Dim mount in
dimMountIn.description: CSS selector of the element the overlay is mounted in. Resolved when the tour starts.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Prefix for classes and data attributes added to page elements. Default vt.

arrows.title: Arrow keys
arrows.description: Whether the arrow keys move between steps.

exitPrompt.title: Exit prompt
exitPrompt.description: false never asks, a string is the question, a handler returns a boolean or promise.

counter.title: Counter
counter.description: true shows the step counter, a handler receives the 1-based index and total and returns the text.

done.title: Done label
done.description: Text of the last step's forward button.

close.title: Close label
close.description: Accessible name of the close button.

animate.title: Animate
animate.description: Whether popovers and the cut-out animate.

waitBudget.title: Wait budget
waitBudget.description: Total milliseconds one navigation may spend waiting for targets across consecutive steps. 0 removes the cap.

stepDefaults.title: Step defaults
stepDefaults.description: Values merged under every step. May hold any step key except id.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The steps of the tour, in order. May be empty.

handler.title: Handler reference
handler.description: Names a function from the handlers map passed to parseTourJson.

handler.title: Handler name
handler.description: Key of the function in the handlers map.

text.title: Text
text.description: A string, or a handler returning the string each time it is needed.

corners.title: Corner radii
corners.description: Radius per corner in CSS pixels. Unset corners keep the default.

topLeft.title: Top left
topLeft.description: Radius of the top left corner.

topRight.title: Top right
topRight.description: Radius of the top right corner.

bottomRight.title: Bottom right
bottomRight.description: Radius of the bottom right corner.

bottomLeft.title: Bottom left
bottomLeft.description: Radius of the bottom left corner.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Corner radius in CSS pixels, one number for all corners or an object per corner.

dim.title: Dim options
dim.description: Appearance and behavior of the dimmed overlay.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Space between the target and the cut-out edge. Default 10.

radius.title: Cut-out radius
radius.description: Cut-out corner radius, uniform or per corner. Default 5.

transitionMs.title: Transition
transitionMs.description: Duration of the cut-out transition between steps, in milliseconds. Default 400.

clickOutside.title: Click outside
clickOutside.description: What a click on the dimmed area does: nothing, exit the tour, or go forward.

pageScroll.title: Page scroll
pageScroll.description: Whether the page can scroll while a step is shown.

lockScrollParent.title: Lock scroll parent
lockScrollParent.description: Freeze the target's scroll parent while a step is shown.

clipToScrollParents.title: Clip to scroll parents
clipToScrollParents.description: Cut out only the part of the target its scroll parents leave visible.

label.title: Button label
label.description: Accessible name of the button, when it differs from the text.

action.title: Button action
action.description: A built-in action, or a handler called with the tour and step.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Whether the button is disabled, or a handler returning that.

classes.title: Button classes
classes.description: CSS class or classes added to the button.

attrs.title: Button attributes
attrs.description: Extra HTML attributes set on the button.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: auto, or an object choosing the side and alignment.

oneOf.title: Placement options
oneOf.description: Side and alignment of the popover.

side.title: Side
side.description: Side of the target; auto picks the best fit, over covers the target.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Gap between target and popover, or an object with the main and cross distances.

main.title: Main offset
main.description: Gap between target and popover. Default 10.

cross.title: Cross offset
cross.description: Shift along the edge the popover sits on. Default 0.

viewportPadding.title: Viewport padding
viewportPadding.description: Distance kept from the boundary. Default 0.

boundary.title: Boundary
boundary.description: What the popover must stay inside: the target's scroll parents or the viewport.

flip.title: Flip
flip.description: Fall back to another side or alignment when the popover does not fit. Default true.

shift.title: Shift
shift.description: Slide along the edge to stay inside the boundary. Default true.

arrow.title: Arrow
arrow.description: false hides the arrow, true shows it, an object sets the closest it gets to a corner.

minInset.title: Minimum inset
minInset.description: Closest the arrow gets to a corner. Default 15.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Overrides the dim padding for this step.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Overrides the dim radius for this step.

extra.title: Extra selectors
extra.description: Extra selectors to cut out and keep interactive.

class.title: Class
class.description: Class added to the target and the extras.

targetInteractive.title: Target interactive
targetInteractive.description: false blocks all interaction with the target; hover-only allows hover but not clicks.

id.title: Step id
id.description: Stable identifier of the step. Used for persistence, goTo and events. Must be unique within the tour.

title.title: Title
title.description: Popover heading: plain text, or a handler returning the text each time the step shows.

body.title: Body
body.description: Popover content as HTML. A list becomes one paragraph per entry. HTML is not sanitized unless the host sets a sanitizer in code.

label.title: Accessible label
label.description: Name announced for the dialog when the step has no title.

closeButton.title: Close button
closeButton.description: false hides the close button, true shows it, an object customizes it.

label.title: Close label
label.description: Accessible name of the close button.

attrs.title: Close attributes
attrs.description: Extra HTML attributes set on the close button.

classes.title: Popover classes
classes.description: CSS class or classes added to the popover.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Any JSON value kept on the step for your own use; never interpreted.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Custom footer buttons. When present, the built-in Next and Back buttons are hidden.

target.title: Target
target.description: CSS selector of the element to highlight, or a handler returning an element or selector.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Where the popover sits relative to the target: auto, or a side with an optional alignment.

waitFor.title: Wait for
waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for the target to appear.

whenMissing.title: When missing
whenMissing.description: What to do when the target never appears: show the step centered or skip it.

shouldShow.title: Should show
shouldShow.description: Handler returning false to skip the step.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.description: Handler run before the step shows; the tour waits for a returned promise.

hookTimeout.title: Hook timeout
hookTimeout.description: Milliseconds prepare and revealWith may each take before the step shows anyway. 0 waits forever.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: How the target is scrolled into view: true or false, smooth, or scroll options.

revealWith.title: Reveal with
revealWith.description: Handler that scrolls the target itself, replacing the built-in scrolling.

autoAdvance.title: Auto advance
autoAdvance.description: Moves to the next step when the user does something.

event.title: Event
event.description: DOM event name or names that advance the tour.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: CSS selector to listen on in the whole document instead of on the target.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Without a selector, block other mouse gestures on the target so only the named event advances.

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.description: Action step: what the user must do before moving on, as HTML, or a handler returning it.

advanceDelay.title: Advance delay
advanceDelay.description: Milliseconds a completed action step stays on screen before the tour moves on.

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: What receives focus when the step shows.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Namespaced bag of presenter data, passed through untouched.
